notTranslated: Ba a fassara wani sashe na wannan shafi ba tukuna, don haka ana nuna shi da Turanci.

index.title: Shahararrun glaze
index.lead: Glaze da aka sani a duk duniya, kowanne daga kayansa na gargajiya na yankinsa, tare da UMF ɗinsa da sigar da aka yi da kayan da ake sayarwa inda kuke.
index.more: Ƙarin glaze na zuwa: ana ƙara kowanne da zarar tsarinsa da kayansa sun dogara ga aƙalla majiyoyi uku da aka karanta.

glaze.lead: Shahararren glaze ({native}): tsarinsa na gargajiya ko nazari, gasarsa, da sigar da aka yi da kayan da ake sayarwa inda kuke.
glaze.historyOnly: Tarihi kawai: an yi wannan glaze da darma (lead, Pb). Ana nuna nazarinsa a matsayin tarihi, ba a matsayin tsarin da za a haɗa ba. Sigar da ke ƙasa wani glaze ne daban, babu darma.
glaze.safeMixing: Haɗawa cikin aminci da iska mai kyau
glaze.firingGuide: Gasa a cikin kiln mai sauƙi

local.heading: Da kayan yankinku
local.intro: UMF na tsarin gargajiya, da aka yi da daidaitattun kayan da ake sayarwa inda kuke saye. Zaɓi inda kuke saye don ganin sa.
local.untested: An lissafa, ba a gasa shi don gwaji ba tukuna.
local.testFirst: Gasa test tile kafin ku yi amfani da shi a kan kowane kayan aiki, kuma ku gwada wurin da abinci ke taɓawa don zubar ƙarfe (leaching).
local.untestedNote: An lissafa, ba a gasa shi don gwaji ba tukuna: gasa test tile kafin amfani.
local.close: Yana kusa sosai da formula da ake nema.
local.fair: Yana kusa da formula da ake nema daidai gwargwado.
local.poor: Waɗannan kayan ba za su iya kusantar formula da ake nema ba.
local.none: Kayan da ake sayarwa a can ba za su iya yin sa ba.
local.choose: Zaɓi inda kuke sayen kaya don ganin an yi shi da waɗanda ake sayarwa a can.
